from collections import Counter
def analyze(g):
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    # bar color: forms long horizontal runs; seed: isolated-ish
    def is_bar_color(v):
        rows=[r for r in range(len(g)) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==v)>=3]
        return len(rows)>=1
    bar=[v for v in rest if is_bar_color(v)]
    seed=[v for v in rest if v not in bar]
    return bg, bar[0] if bar else None, seed[0] if seed else None
def bars2(g,bar):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); hs=[]
    for r in range(R):
        seg=[c for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==bar]
        if len(seg)>=3: hs.append((r,min(seg),max(seg)))
    return hs
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg,bar,seed=analyze(g)
    if bar is None: return g
    bs=bars2(g,bar)
    if len(bs)!=2: return g
    ds=dots(g)
    if not ds: return g
    (r1,a1,b1),(r2,a2,b2)=bs
    for (r,c) in ds:
        d1=min(abs(c-a1),abs(c-b1)); d2=min(abs(c-a2),abs(c-b2))
        if d1<d2 or (d1==d2 and r1<r2): rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r1,a1,b1,r2,a2,b2
        else: rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r2,a2,b2,r1,a1,b1
        mc=aM+(c-aA)
        if rA<r: rng=range(rA+1,r)
        else: rng=range(r+1,rA)
        for rr in rng: g[rr][c]=seed
        g[r][c]=4
        for rr in range(R):
            if g[rr][mc]!=bar: g[rr][mc]=seed
    return g
res={}
for name,i,o in allpairs:
    t=transform(i); d=diff(t,o); res[name]=len(d)
    print(name, len(d), d[:4])

def transform(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]; R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    def maxrun(v):
        n=0
        for row in g:
            run=0
            for x in row:
                run=run+1 if x==v else 0; n=max(n,run)
        for c in range(C):
            run=0
            for r in range(R):
                run=run+1 if g[r][c]==v else 0; n=max(n,run)
        return n
    order=sorted(rest,key=lambda v:-maxrun(v))
    bar=order[0] if maxrun(order[0])>=2 else None
    seed=order[1] if len(order)>1 else None
    if bar is None or seed is None: return g
    def segs_row(M):
        out=[]
        for r,row in enumerate(M):
            cs=[c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==bar]
            if len(cs)>=2 and len(cs)==max(cs)-min(cs)+1: out.append((r,min(cs),max(cs)))
        return out
    sr=segs_row(g)
    sc=segs_row([[g[r][c] for r in range(R)] for c in range(C)])
    if len(sr)==2: B=g; T=False
    elif len(sc)==2: B=[[g[r][c] for r in range(R)] for c in range(C)]; T=True
    else: return g
    RB,CB=len(B),len(B[0])
    (r1,a1,b1),(r2,a2,b2)=sr if not T else sc
    ds=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(B) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==seed]
    for (r,c) in ds:
        d1=min(abs(c-a1),abs(c-b1)); d2=min(abs(c-a2),abs(c-b2))
        if d1<d2 or (d1==d2 and r1<r2): rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r1,a1,b1,r2,a2,b2
        else: rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r2,a2,b2,r1,a1,b1
        if rA<r: gap=list(range(rA+1,r)); step=1
        elif rA>r: gap=list(range(r+1,rA)); step=-1
        else: gap=[]; step=0
        if gap:
            for rr in gap: B[rr][c]=seed
            B[r][c]=4
        else:
            rr=r-step  # zero-gap: one cell beyond dot away from attach bar
            if 0<=rr<RB: B[rr][c]=4
        m=bM-(bA-c)
        if 0<=m<CB:
            for rr in range(RB):
                if B[rr][m]!=bar: B[rr][m]=seed
    if T: return [[B[c][r] for c in range(C)] for r in range(R)]
    return B
allok=True
for name,ii,oo in allpairs:
    t=transform(ii); dd=diff(t,oo); ok=not dd; allok&=ok
    print(name,'OK' if ok else f'{len(dd)} diffs {dd[:5]}')
print('ALL',allok)

def transform(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]; R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=sorted([v for v in cnt if v!=bg])
    def mr(v):
        n=0
        for row in g:
            run=0
            for x in row:
                run=run+1 if x==v else 0; n=max(n,run)
        for cc in range(C):
            run=0
            for rr in range(R):
                run=run+1 if g[rr][cc]==v else 0; n=max(n,run)
        return n
    order=sorted(rest,key=lambda v:-mr(v))
    bar=order[0] if mr(order[0])>=2 else None
    seed=order[1] if len(order)>1 else None
    if bar is None or seed is None: return g
    def segs(M):
        out=[]
        for r,row in enumerate(M):
            cs=[c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==bar]
            if len(cs)>=2 and len(cs)==max(cs)-min(cs)+1: out.append((r,min(cs),max(cs)))
        return out
    sr=segs(g)
    sc=segs([[g[r][c] for r in range(R)] for c in range(C)])
    if len(sr)==2: B=g; T=False
    elif len(sc)==2: B=[[g[r][c] for r in range(R)] for c in range(C)]; T=True
    else: return g
    RB,CB=len(B),len(B[0])
    (r1,a1,b1),(r2,a2,b2)=sr if not T else sc
    def dist(a,b,c): return 0 if a<=c<=b else min(abs(c-a),abs(c-b))
    ds=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(B) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==seed]
    for (r,c) in ds:
        d1=dist(a1,b1,c); d2=dist(a2,b2,c)
        if d1<d2 or (d1==d2 and r1<r2): rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r1,a1,b1,r2,a2,b2
        else: rA,aA,bA,rM,aM,bM=r2,a2,b2,r1,a1,b1
        lo,hi=min(rA,r),max(rA,r)
        between=list(range(lo+1,hi))
        if between:
            for rr in between: B[rr][c]=seed
            B[r][c]=4
        else:

        m=bM-(bA-c)

        if gap==0: m+=s

    if T: return [[B[c][r] for c in range(C)] for r in range(R)]

''')
